display.purpose: h1 of a desk page; Barlow Condensed, uppercase.

headline.purpose: h2 panel headings; Barlow Condensed, uppercase.

title.purpose: h3 labels inside panels and the why pane, steel, often led by a 14px icon.

body.purpose: Running text; paragraphs cap at 64 to 72ch.

label.purpose: Flags, inbox kinds, filters, treatment tags. Sentence case.

figure.purpose: Amounts, ids, policy keys, check ids and times, tabular.

figure-strong.purpose: The headline value of a legend or desk line.

axis.purpose: Chart ticks, the cap track axis and the now label, muted.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The chart tooltip on the shift and the revenue charts. The only shadow on the dashboard.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve, for state changes and the cap track wipe.

motion.name: cap-wipe
motion.purpose: The one motion moment: the cap track bar wipes in left to right. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Status Flags
components.description: The three lamps, each with its icon and a word: approved, waiting, refused.
components.html: Approved Waiting for the Controller Rejected
components.css: .ds-flags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2b323a); border-radius: 2px; font: 600 12px var(--body, 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-flag--ok { border-color: rgba(201, 255, 75, 0.45); background: var(--lime-wash, rgba(201, 255, 75, 0.1)); color: var(--lime, #c9ff4b); } .ds-flag--hold { border-color: rgba(255, 181, 71, 0.45); background: var(--hold-wash, rgba(255, 181, 71, 0.1)); color: var(--hold, #ffb547); } .ds-flag--alert { border-color: rgba(255, 114, 95, 0.45); background: var(--alert-wash, rgba(255, 114, 95, 0.1)); color: var(--alert, #ff725f); }

components.name: Filter Tabs
components.description: Hairline filters that act as tabs, with a muted mono count.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2b323a); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--steel, #aab5bc); font: 600 12.5px var(--body, 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); border-color: var(--steel, #aab5bc); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime, #c9ff4b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-filter--on { color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); border-color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); background: var(--panel-2, #111823); } .ds-filter-n { font: 400 11.5px var(--mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted, #8f98a1); }

components.name: Reason Field

components.name: Inbox Row
components.description: A waiting item: kind icon and label, title, proposal, mono amount, amber 'for' line. Selected raises and outlines in steel.
components.css: .ds-inbox { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--body, 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 136px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: 'kind title amount' 'kind sub needs'; gap: 2px 14px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel-2, #111823); color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), background 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)); } .ds-row:hover { border-color: var(--line, #2b323a); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime, #c9ff4b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row--on { border-color: var(--steel, #aab5bc); background: var(--raise, #151d29); } .ds-row-kind { grid-area: kind; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; align-self: start; color: var(--steel, #aab5bc); font: 600 12px var(--body, 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-row-title { grid-area: title; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-amt { grid-area: amount; font: 600 12.5px var(--mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-row-sub { grid-area: sub; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted, #8f98a1); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-prop { color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); } .ds-row-needs { grid-area: needs; justify-self: end; color: var(--hold, #ffb547); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Cap Track
components.description: Relevant Costs against the cap on one bar: lime posted, steel proposed, outlined unclassified; ink cap line, coral breach line; the system's one wipe.
components.html: cap $215m+5% breach
components.css: .ds-track { position: relative; margin: 26px 0 8px; padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-track-bar { position: relative; height: 18px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line-soft, #1b222b); animation: ds-wipe 900ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) both; } @keyframes ds-wipe { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-track-bar { animation: none; } } .ds-seg { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; } .ds-seg--posted { background: var(--lime, #c9ff4b); border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px; } .ds-seg--proposed { background: var(--steel, #aab5bc); } .ds-seg--open { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--muted, #8f98a1); } .ds-cap, .ds-breach { position: absolute; top: -8px; height: 34px; width: 0; } .ds-cap { border-left: 2px solid var(--ink, #f3f3f0); } .ds-breach { border-left: 1px solid var(--alert, #ff725f); } .ds-cap b, .ds-breach b { position: absolute; bottom: 100%; padding-bottom: 3px; white-space: nowrap; font: 600 11px var(--mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); } .ds-cap b { right: 4px; } .ds-breach b { left: 5px; color: var(--alert, #ff725f); font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ink, #f3f3f0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime, #c9ff4b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 26px; background: var(--lime, #c9ff4b); color: #06080a; font: 800 13px var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.04em; transform: skewX(-12deg); clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 100% 0, 90% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-word { display: block; font: 800 19px/1 var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-word span { color: var(--lime, #c9ff4b); } .ds-brand small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font: 600 9.5px var(--body, 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--muted, #8f98a1); }

narrative.overview:
Pit Wall is a race team's finance desk read the way a pit wall reads a race: one dark ground, a few hairlines, and one bright signal that means a human made the call. Every actor (FIA feed, sync job, Claude seats, standing approvals, the two people, the ERP gateway, the red team) gets a lane on a shared time axis, so separation of duties is something you see, not something you are told. The landing page (`landing/`) is the parent world; the dashboard keeps its ground, hairlines, lime and three faces, and drops its theatre (livery glow, scene shadows, looping cues) for reading sizes and working density.

The surface is dense and calm. Panels are flat slabs one step lighter than the ground, edged with a hairline and cornered at 2px. Text is DM Sans at 14px; numbers, ids, codes and times are IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures; only page and section headings speak in Barlow Condensed capitals. Colour is almost entirely neutral, so that the three status lamps (lime approved, amber waiting, coral refused) carry their meaning by contrast with everything else. Summaries are sentences and definition lines with the figure inline, never a wall of KPI tiles. The why sits next to the number.

Dark only. The stylesheet declares `color-scheme: dark` and there is no light theme; do not add one.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with tonal panels and hairline edges; no elevation except the floating tooltip.
Lime is a person's signature or the button that lets them sign; amber is waiting; coral is refused. Each ships with an icon and a word.
Barlow Condensed capitals for h1 and h2 only; DM Sans for everything a person reads or clicks; Plex Mono for every figure.
2px corners throughout; the skewed lime brandmark is the only slanted shape.
One motion moment: the cap track wipes in left to right. Everything else is a 160ms state change.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: In the work, lime means a person signed it or this is the button that lets them sign. If a lime pixel cannot be traced to a human approval or the primary action, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Three Lamps Rule
rules.body: Lime approved, amber waiting, coral refused, and each lamp ships with its icon (check, clock or question, cross) and a word ("Approved", "Waiting for the Controller", "Rejected"). A lamp colour on text without an icon is drift, not precedent.

rules.name: The Neutral Series Rule
rules.body: Data series are the world's greys (`s1`, `s2`, `steel`, `muted`). The three lamps never encode a series, so a coloured mark on a chart always means a status.

rules.name: The Two-Headline Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed capitals belong to h1 and h2 only. Body, labels, buttons and numbers never set in Barlow. The one sanctioned exception is the why pane's title, which carries a record's own name: it sets in Barlow at 22px in the record's own case (a memo, an invoice), and a policy key sets in Plex Mono 600 at 16px because it is a code.

rules.name: The Timing Screen Rule
rules.body: Every money amount, id, code, time and check result is Plex Mono with tabular figures, right-aligned in tables. A number set in DM Sans is a bug.

rules.name: The Ground Plane Rule
rules.body: Panels sit on the ground; they are never lifted. If something needs to feel above the page, it is a tooltip, and it is the only thing that casts a shadow.

rules.name: The 2px Rule
rules.body: Corners are 2px or 1px. No pills, no circles on containers, no radius above 2px. (The cost-cap bars currently round their right end at 3px; treat that as drift.)

dos: Do keep lime for a person's approval and the primary action (plus the brand's own marks and the focus ring), so a lime pixel always means a human signed.
Do pair every status with its icon and a word: check + "Approved", clock + "Waiting for the Controller", cross + "Rejected" or "refused".
Do show a refused attempt where it happened: a coral cross on the lane that tried, a coral outcome in the why pane, a 4% coral row in the audit table.
Do set every figure, id, code and time in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures, right-aligned in tables.
Do build depth from the four tones (ground, panel, inset, raised) and two hairlines (`line-soft` for panel edges and row dividers, `line` for controls, table heads and the shell rule).
Do use the desk's own icon set: 16px grid, 1.6 stroke, square caps, miter joins, `currentColor`.
Do put the figure inside a sentence or a definition line ("$X of Relevant Costs posted against a $215m cap"), with the why next to it.
Do keep 2px corners on everything that has a corner.
donts: Don't add a light theme; the desk is dark only.
Don't colour a data series, a hover, a connection indicator or a decoration lime, amber or coral; chart series are `s1`, `s2`, `steel` and `muted`.
Don't let a status colour stand alone on a word or a dot without its icon.
Don't set body text, labels, buttons or numbers in Barlow Condensed, and don't track small labels into spaced capitals.
Don't lift dashboard panels with shadows or glows; only the tooltip floats.
Don't round anything past 2px or make a pill.
Don't animate content in. The cap track's wipe is the one motion moment; everything else is a 160ms state change, and all of it stops under reduced motion.
Don't summarise a desk with a row of KPI tiles.
